name: multi-defect-grouping-reduction
description: Three project-owned seeded defects: two parser defects raise identical IndexError at different sites, plus an ordering-dependent intermittent timing defect. Used to verify same-exception grouping, site-preserving reduction, repeated-trial evidence, and budget-exhaustion resume.

failure_policy.rejected: expected parser rejection, not a finding
failure_policy.crash: group by exception type plus raise site; reduce while preserving both and the key condition
failure_policy.timeout: separate timeout finding; never merge with crashes
failure_policy.runner_error: preserve current sample and abnormal process exit code
failure_policy.flaky: repeat trials and record hits/trials; never discard after one failed reproduction
failure_policy.resume: original samples, per-step reduction reasons and the generator index are reloaded from the checkpoint
